titel: UAP EP 227 China's Hidden UFO History part 2

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst art19.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Uncovering centuries of hidden UFO history and strange close encounters in China.
kurzfassung: The hosts explore China's hidden UFO history by examining historical accounts from centuries ago, such as glowing orbs and medieval abductions. They also analyze modern waves of sightings, focusing on a famous 1994 close encounter and alleged physical evidence. The episode highlights striking parallels between ancient reports and contemporary UAP phenomena.
stichpunkte: Early Chinese records from a thousand years ago document glowing orbs and unidentified submerged objects.
A well-respected scholar in 1060 described a recurring glowing pearl that illuminated landscapes for miles.
Poet Su Dongpo recorded a silent, glowing object making sharp turns across the night sky in 1071.
A 500-year-old historical manuscript details a stonemason's one-year disappearance and subsequent abduction account.
Nationwide sightings in the early 1980s led to the creation of the Beijing UFO Research Organization.
Lumberjack Meng Xiaogo reported multiple close encounters and a physical abduction by tall beings in 1994.
Investigators testing a space rock given to Meng found it rich in terbium, an element typical of the asteroid belt.
Anomalous radiation and physical scorch marks were later documented at the site of Meng's alleged encounter.

kapitel.titel: 1980s Wave and the Beijing UFO Research Organization

clips.text: Ancient scholars and record keepers were documenting mysterious glowing orbs in the sky a millennium ago, showing that the phenomenon is nothing new.

clips.hook: No sound and nothing to compare it to
clips.text: Ancient observers noted that these anomalous aerial objects moved in complete silence during an era when human-made flying machines did not exist.
Following an alleged close encounter, the medieval stonemason vanished completely and did not reappear in his village until twelve months later.
The lumberjack woke up in sudden terror to find himself completely immobilized and floating horizontally above his bed.

clips.hook: Undeniable signs of an aircraft landing
clips.text: The head of a prominent UFO research group inspected the remote forest location and confirmed clear physical evidence that a craft had landed and departed.

beschreibung:
In this continuation, Stephen Diener concludes his series on the sightings and experiences of UFOs in China with some remarkable and maybe even unexplainable first hand accounts of UFOs from 1,000 years ago. Along with a couple of inexplicable abduction accounts as well. These are stories that will absolutely stick with you after you hear them...
